# Bishal Mistri — Product Designer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Bishal Mistri, a product designer. Case studies, writing, photography, and design experiments.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.bishalmistri.com/): Work, writing, and about — the main portfolio.
- [Design System case study](https://www.bishalmistri.com/casestudy/design-system): Building a design system.
- [Xyvot case study](https://www.bishalmistri.com/casestudy/xyvot): Designing a local business platform.
- [Friender case study](https://www.bishalmistri.com/casestudy/friender): A friendship-finding app concept.
- [Dock](https://www.bishalmistri.com/dock): A macOS-style dock of tools and links.
- [Travel](https://www.bishalmistri.com/travel): Photography from travels.
- [Playground](https://www.bishalmistri.com/playground): Design experiments and interactions.

## About

Bishal Mistri is a product designer interested in arts, coffee, online games, and travelling. He writes about UX design and shares photography on Pexels.
